one_line: Zoho's team collaboration chat platform with a REST API for users, teams, channels, chats, messages, bots, reminders, events, and files.
auth_notes: REST API uses OAuth 2.0 (scopes); apps registered in Zoho developer console. Multiple data-center domains (9) with per-region base URIs.
self_serve_notes: Self-serve; free and paid plans, API works on free orgs. OAuth app registration free.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: V2/V3 REST API: users, roles, teams, departments, channels, chats, messages, threads, bots, events, files, bulk export; 100+ endpoints, OAS available.
api_surface.webhook_note: Bot webhook URLs and extension webhooks supported for delivering events.

existing_mcp.note: No official MCP server confirmed; community MCP wrappers may exist (unverified).

evidence.note: Fetched text (023_zoho_cliq.txt) is the full API docs: OAuth 2.0 auth, REST root endpoint, endpoint list, data centers.

agent_notes: Text lists V3 as latest but intro text references /v2/ path; webhook support inferred from knowledge.
